objectives.name: Metadata encoding
objectives.summary: API responses should return metadata encoded in JSON-LD, at least as an option, using the minimal metadata types and properties.

objectives.name: IRI (URL) structure
objectives.summary: Endpoints should be resource-oriented IRIs such as /datasets/{dataset_id}. Avoid verbs and complex query strings in the path. These IRIs can also serve as JSON-LD @id values.

objectives.name: HTTP method
objectives.summary: Retrieve metadata with HTTP GET. POST is acceptable when parameters must travel in the body because of size, complexity, or security.

objectives.name: Documentation
objectives.summary: Publish API documentation that follows OpenAPI/Swagger so both people and machines can read it.

fallbacks.name: HTML-embedded metadata
fallbacks.summary: If a repository cannot ship an API, put structured metadata (JSON-LD) directly in the webpage that describes the resource.

fallbacks.name: Object server
fallbacks.summary: An endpoint that delivers the bytes of a digital object or its metadata, rather than the repository that stores them.

fallbacks.name: Downloadable index
fallbacks.summary: A computer-readable index of metadata that can be fetched without a query API.

fallbacks.name: Queryable knowledge graph
fallbacks.summary: Repositories with stronger API infrastructure may add complementary services such as a queryable metadata graph.
